svg.text: DATA LAB ROUND 11 · ENTERPRISE DATAOPS, GIT (PBIP/TMDL), VARIABLE LIBRARIES & TERRAFORM VS 4 CLOUDS
Fabric Git (PBIP/TMDL) + Variable Libraries + Deployment Pipelines vs. DABs vs. SnowCLI vs. Dataform / CodePipeline
Provenance: [measured_local_harness] 87/88 (98.86%) · [synthetic_scenario_model] Matrix n=88 Mean=491.0ms | Ontology n=18 Mean=519.0ms (Scenario R=383ms) · [not_measured] Live Cloud
1. Why Legacy BI + Data Releases Break vs. Fabric Unified Git (PBIP/TMDL)
❌ Legacy Stitched Stack (DABs + SnowCLI + Opaque Binary .pbix Uploads)
• Code-only CI/CD (DABs / SnowCLI) deploys tables & PySpark jobs but leaves Power BI .pbix as a binary black box
• Two engineers editing DAX measures in .pbix cannot Git-diff or merge → silent overwrites in Production
• Hardcoded Dev/UAT connection strings leak into Prod or require fragile post-deploy PowerShell regex scripts
• Feature-branch testing copies TB-scale tables per developer sandbox, multiplying cloud storage & ops overhead
Synthetic Scenario R Baseline: $28,400/mo DataOps TCO · 18-min manual rollback window · High drift risk
✅ Fabric Git Integration (PBIP/TMDL) + Variable Libraries + Zero-Copy Branching
• PBIP + TMDL: Serializes semantic models, DAX measures, KQL & notebooks into human-readable Git text files
• Zero-Copy Branch Out: Creates isolated Dev feature workspaces referencing OneLake Shortcuts ($0 extra storage)
• Fabric Variable Libraries: Dynamically binds Dev / UAT / Prod Shortcuts & Key Vault secrets without code edits
• Deployment Pipelines REST API + fabric-cicd + Terraform Provider (microsoft/fabric) promote 64 items atomically
• Better Together: Pair DABs / Snowflake CREATE OR ALTER with Fabric TMDL + Apache Ossie YAML in one Git PR
Synthetic Scenario R: $6,800/mo (-$21,600/mo, -76.1%) · 0 connection drift · 383ms E2E · $2.12M SLA Protected
2. Enterprise DataOps Selection Rules & Scenario R Breakdown (383 ms)
Rule 1 — Full-Stack Lakehouse + Eventhouse KQL + Power BI DirectLake Release
Choose Fabric Git (PBIP/TMDL) + Variable Libraries + Deployment Pipelines + Terraform Provider microsoft/fabric.
Rule 2 — Pure PySpark/MLflow Bundles or Pure Cloud Warehouse SQL DDL
Choose Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs databricks.yml), Snowflake Git + SnowCLI, or GCP Dataform SQLX.
Rule 3 — Hybrid Multi-Cloud Coordinated Contract Release (Better Together)
Orchestrate DABs / SnowCLI + Fabric fabric-cicd & Apache Ossie YAML from one GitHub Actions / ADO pipeline.
Scenario R [synthetic_scenario_model]: Global Payments 14-Region PCI-DSS v4.0 Release (383 ms)
1. Git PBIP/TMDL AST Diff (128 DAX measures): 92ms | 2. Variable Library 14-Region Shortcut Binding: 110ms
3. Fabric IQ Ontology Contract Pre-Flight: 96ms | 4. Deployment Pipeline + Terraform Atomic Commit: 85ms
Guardrail [FIN-PCI-DSS-V4-CHANGE-CONTROL-SOP-014]: Blocks binary .pbix overwrite & UAT connection leaks → Confirm
Dual Denominators: Matrix n=88 Mean = 491.0 ms (87/88 = 98.86%) | Ontology Simulations n=18 Mean = 519.0 ms (R10 n=17=527.0ms)
